_help.site_name: Required for all scripts. Site/PC label shown on logs and reports.
_help.client: Optional. Legal client name for the invoice trail.
_help.upgrade_source: Win11-Upgrade: 'installationassistant' (download + run MS assistant) or 'iso' (use iso_path).
_help.iso_path: Win11-Upgrade: full path to a Windows 11 ISO when upgrade_source is 'iso'. Ignored otherwise.
_help.installation_assistant_url: Win11-Upgrade: override the assistant download URL if needed. Default is Microsoft's fwlink.
_help.min_free_gb: Win11-Upgrade: minimum free GB required on the system drive before upgrading (default 25).
_help.computer_name: New-PC-Setup: rename the PC to this. Leave empty to skip renaming.
_help.workgroup: New-PC-Setup: workgroup to join. Leave empty to skip. Ignored if 'domain' is set.
_help.domain: New-PC-Setup: AD domain to join. Prompts for credentials at runtime (never stored). Leave empty to skip.
_help.timezone: New-PC-Setup: Windows timezone Id, e.g. 'Eastern Standard Time'. List with: Get-TimeZone -ListAvailable.
_help.monitor_timeout_min: New-PC-Setup: minutes before the display (monitor) turns off on AC power. This is the monitor-off timeout only - it does not lock the screen or put the PC to sleep.
_help.winget_apps: New-PC-Setup: list of exact winget package IDs to install. Already-installed apps are skipped.
_help.debloat_extra: Debloat: extra Appx package name patterns to ADD to the curated removal list.
_help.debloat_keep: Debloat: Appx package name patterns to REMOVE from the removal list (keep them installed).
